meta.title: Mexico City metro entrance
meta.caption: People pass behind others; watch whether the same ID comes back.

gate.name: walk
gate.how: perpendicular to the dominant walking direction of the tracks (both trackers pooled), through the median track mid-point; no tracker count is used

guide.rule: every moment where at least one tracker changed a person's number: a number disappears and a new number appears in the same place (box overlap >= 0.3) within 1 s
